name: Sika® Confibre® 51F
summary: Sika® Confibre® 51F is a fibrillated polypropylene fibre for use in concrete to reduce the incidence of plastic shrinkage cracking. Sika® Confibre® 51F increases the strain capacity of the fresh concrete therefore reducing plastic cracking.

items.label: CERTIFICATES AND TEST REPORTS
items.text:
Complies with ASTM C1116/ C1116M, Type III fiber re-inforced concrete and therefore ASTM D7508.
Complies with European Standard EN 14889-2:2006 Fibres for Concrete Part 2, Class 1b .

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: Product can be stored for indefinite period in a dry environment.

items.label: Recommended dosage
items.text:
The recommended minimum dose rate of Sika Confibre 51F is 0.9kg (1 bag) per cubic metre of concrete.
Optimum dosage depends on the type of concrete, site conditions, mix proportions and desired plastic and hardened concrete properties. Laboratory and/or field trials are essential in determining the optimum dosage.
